name: io-mcp
description: Indian Opinion MCP server (Cloudflare Worker): a thin adapter over the REST agent API, plus the agent discovery files
author: Indian Opinion <hello@indianopinion.org>

scripts.check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist -c $(test -f wrangler.toml && echo wrangler.toml || echo wrangler.example.toml)
